navaid.name: Prinz Eugen
navaid.description: German cruiser transferred to the US Navy after WWII and used in the Operation Crossroads nuclear tests at Bikini Atoll. Damaged and contaminated by the blast, she was subsequently towed to Kwajalein where she took on water and capsized five months later.

navaid.name: Chromite (BCL-2570/BCL-3098)
navaid.description: WWII US Army concrete barge sunk as a breakwater
